links.label: demo: Omnibox over the real site index

set.outcome:
**A keyboard-first Omnibox lands** — `/` or Ctrl/Cmd+K opens a field that stays visible in the shell even closed, ranks the current topic's subtree before the whole site (an exact-title match still jumps every local guess), and borrows the destination's own `preview()` for whatever is highlighted. Proven live over the real ~1,056-url index.

- [ext/Omnibox docs](/framework/ext/Omnibox/) — the class, the CSS, the readme
- [Demo: over the real site index](/imagine/platform/omnibox/) — three scripted scenarios, bound to the Platform topic
- [Interaction-model verdicts](/framework/ext/Omnibox/doc/decisions/) — the visible-field call, what "strong" means, the Space-bar verdict and the one query it gets wrong

![](shots/1280-arrowdown2-accordion.png)

Index measured live in-browser: **1,056 urls in 9.6ms** — one fetch of `/directory.json`, no crawl, no server. `ui-test` proved open(`/`) → type → arrow ×2 → Enter changes the url at 400 and 1280 (screenshots in `shots/`); zero console errors at 400/1280/1920/3440.

Left out, on purpose: content search inside a page, users, and a real command palette (three hardcoded links, to prove the branch only) — all named on the demo's own "Not now" section. Nothing was cut from the closed list — budget held.
